reviews.comment:
店面沒有寫禁帶外食⋯
老闆直接一張臭臉說為什麼帶外食進來不會先禮貌的問一下⋯
很想問一下你們店面都沒有任何的說明不能帶外食， 而且我們吃帶進來要吃之前也有先問而不是一進店就拿起來吃好嗎😑 超級無語， 你要是說有寫禁帶外食那我還拿進去了那就是我有毛病好嗎， 你總不可能沒寫禁帶外食禁用外食這些然後讓我們買其他店家的東西不拿進去店裡吧😑， 不然你們也可以外面放個籃子給人放外食的這樣才知道你們不給帶外食好嗎⋯
都不知道臉在臭什麼的😑態度讓人不想吃東西。
（ps . 後面是家裡人在裡面吃說餐點好吃）

(Translated by Google)
The store didn't have a sign saying "No Outside Food Allowed"... The owner had a really sour face and asked why I brought in outside food without politely asking first... I really want to ask, your store doesn't have any signs saying "No Outside Food Allowed," and you asked before we brought it in to eat, instead of just taking it in and eating it right away, okay? 😑 It's incredibly frustrating. If you said there was a sign saying "No Outside Food Allowed," then I'd be the one who's crazy for bringing it in, okay? You can't just not have a sign saying "No Outside Food Allowed" and then expect us to buy things from other stores and not bring them into the store, right? 😑 Otherwise, you could put a basket outside for people to put their outside food in so they know you don't allow it, okay? The owner's sour face and attitude made me not want to eat.

(ps. My family ate there and said the food was delicious)

reviews.comment:
我自認我是食量大的人，所以我才點了飯多，確實最後剩下一點飯我也有問題，但老實說有蠻大一部分是飯的醬汁太鹹了，我吃不下去。但我也不想再另外叫免費的雞油拌飯讓整體不那麼鹹，因為我知道我叫了我也吃不完。
我跟我母親並非貪心佔便宜的人，只是我們沒想到貴店的食物跟我們平常吃的口味對不上而已。
或許對老闆您來說，您看到的是我跟我母親碗裡都有剩東西，但您僅以這點就來評斷我跟我母親的人格，讓我們很不舒服。
之前來貴店消費的時候，可能是因為我都有把食物吃完，所以沒受到這樣的待遇，但這次的消費經驗真的讓我很不舒服。
您回覆我母親時，要求我們換位思考。是的，浪費糧食確實不對。
但是否能邀請您換位思考我們的角度？當您去同一間店消費幾次，那幾次都有把食物吃完，但只有一次，因為食物太鹹吃不完，就被指點成貪心、浪費食物的人，是您會怎麼想？

(Translated by Google)
I consider myself to have a large appetite, which is why I ordered so much rice. It's true that I was partly responsible for leaving some, but honestly, a large part of it was because the sauce was too salty; I couldn't eat it. I didn't want to order the free chicken oil rice to make it less salty, because I knew I wouldn't be able to finish it anyway.

My mother and I aren't greedy or trying to take advantage of others; we just didn't expect your restaurant's food to be different from what we usually eat.

Perhaps to you, the owner, you only saw that my mother and I had leftovers, but judging our character based solely on that makes us very uncomfortable.

Previously, when we dined at your restaurant, I didn't receive this treatment, probably because I finished my food, but this experience has truly made me very uncomfortable.

When you replied to my mother, you asked us to put ourselves in her shoes. Yes, wasting food is wrong.

But could you please try to see things from our perspective? If you go to the same store several times and finish your food each time, but only once, because the food was too salty and you couldn't finish it, you are accused of being greedy and wasting food, how would you feel?
reviews.name: accounts/112884798662846885062/locations/1774177451467087781/reviews/AbFvOqny7fkRMOhbHz2sSbTroXXX1plIgU9aZSh4poBOj-gTniJFain0SevjA1kE0OBuCOfjEi-UyQ

reviews.comment:
飯沒吃完老闆會訓人，對於食量無法百分之百精準預測，可能不小心會吃不完的客人，請慎入，
當老闆問你、要飯多，飯少，還是正常時，要小心回覆
還有當你覺得丼飯太鹹，想要一碗單純白飯來配時，要小心，因為吃不完，老闆就會訓你浪費
還有，我們不是乞丐，沒有要老闆你白給白飯，您既然決定不收錢，就有氣度一點
我們依照指示幫忙回收分類
您過來看我們有沒有把白飯吃完
還一邊訓示我們浪費
我女兒點鰻魚飯多，剩一點飯被訓，我因為丼飯太鹹，點一碗白飯，剩一點沒有吃完，被訓
真的是一間讓人害怕的餐廳

還有，請不要隨便汙衊人，我們不是貪心的人，我第一次點鰻魚飯外帶，因為家裡有白飯，我還特意說我不要白飯，但您可能不方便這樣出餐，跟我說您的白飯好吃，要我一起帶白飯，所以，我們不是貪心，浪費的人，只是在內用時，無法精準預測食量
還有，我點的是白飯，您的同事卻送上雞油飯，我有些傻眼，因為丼飯重油重鹹，再配雞油飯其實是負擔，但為了不要讓人覺得我們找麻煩，我也就不再訴求，所以，請不要以為，我們是有多愛吃那個雞油飯
還有啊，原來我點的丼飯裡的飯，我已吃到碗底，剩下一口飯泡了一堆很鹹的豬肉，及泡菜，我才點白飯，也不是您說的碗裡還一堆飯，請不要亂冤枉人
另外，真的就是只剩一點飯，絕對不是您說的很多，
您就在旁邊訓人，讓我想到女兒小時候，吃不完飯，被幼稚園老師霸凌狠逼硬吃光飯，吃到吐出來的事件
您的行為，真是令人害怕

(Translated by Google)
The owner will scold you if you don't finish your food. Since it's impossible to accurately predict your appetite, customers who might not finish their meals should think twice before ordering.

Be careful how you answer when the owner asks if you want a lot, a little, or a normal amount of rice.

Also, be careful if you think the donburi is too salty and want a bowl of plain rice to go with it, because if you don't finish it, the owner will scold you for wasting food.

And please, we're not beggars, we're not asking you to give us free rice. If you've decided not to charge us, please be considerate.

We help with recycling and sorting according to instructions.

You come over to see if we've finished our rice.

And you scold us for wasting food.

My daughter ordered a lot of eel rice and was scolded for leaving a little. I ordered a bowl of plain rice because the donburi was too salty, and was scolded for leaving a little.

It's truly a scary restaurant.

Also, please don't slander us. We're not greedy people. The first time I ordered eel rice to go, I specifically said I didn't want plain rice because I had rice at home, but you might not be comfortable with that. You served me this, telling me my white rice was delicious and asking me to bring my own. So, we're not greedy or wasteful; we just can't accurately predict our appetite when eating in.

Also, I ordered white rice, but your colleague brought chicken rice instead. I was a bit taken aback because the donburi was already quite oily and salty, and pairing it with chicken rice was actually a burden. But to avoid seeming like we were causing trouble, I didn't complain. So please don't assume we particularly loved that chicken rice.

Furthermore, I had already eaten almost all the rice in my donburi bowl; there was only a mouthful left, soaked in a lot of very salty pork and kimchi, before I ordered white rice. It wasn't like you said there was still a lot of rice left in the bowl. Please don't make unfounded accusations.

Furthermore, there really was only a little rice left, definitely not as much as you claimed.

You were scolding me while I was there, which reminded me of my daughter when she was little, being bullied and forced to finish her food by her kindergarten teacher until she vomited.

Your behavior is truly frightening.

reviews.comment:
這是一家可以帶毛小孩進去吃飯的餐廳，非常好．但是要特別注意衞生喔！客人走後我看到的是擦桌子和擦狗坐的椅子是同一條抹布，也沒有噴酒精，二條狗坐2張椅子為什麼只擦一張？而且我還看到毛在燈光下飛舞。我還坐了一下等等看你們會不會二次清潔，發現並沒有，這樣的衞生環境，太令人不舒服了！（不要說保證毛小孩大完便都有擦屁股，24小時都用抱的沒下來走，你不是主人沒24小時看著他們）

(Translated by Google)
This is a restaurant where you can bring your pets, which is great. However, please pay special attention to hygiene! After the customers left, I noticed that the same cloth was used to wipe the tables and the chairs where the dogs sat. There was no alcohol spray either. Why was only one chair wiped when two dogs sat on it? I also saw fur flying around under the lights. I sat there for a while to see if they would clean it again, but they didn't. This kind of hygiene is extremely unpleasant! (Don't tell me you guarantee that you wipe your pets' bottoms after they poop, or that you carry them 24/7. You're not their owner; you're not watching them 24/7.)

reviewReply.comment: 謝謝您這麼直接、也很用心地提醒我們🙏 先說聲抱歉，讓您在用餐時感到不舒服，這真的不是我們希望帶給客人的感受。您提到的清潔細節與觀察，我們都有看到，也能理解您對衛生的在意，尤其是在寵物友善的環境裡，這一點更重要。您的提醒對我們來說是很大的警惕，我們會重新檢視內用清潔的流程與標準，讓來用餐的客人能更安心。謝謝您願意花時間留下這麼真實的回饋。

reviews.comment:
泰式雞腿超讚，雞腿皮很酥脆、重點是闆娘自製的酸辣醬汁，好讚～～～
而且餐點弄得乾乾淨淨，闆娘還會怕你吃不飽問要不要加雞油拌飯，很暖心☺️
湯包也很不錯，好吃到來不及拍照就沒了

(Translated by Google)
The Thai-style chicken drumsticks were amazing! The skin was so crispy, and the owner's homemade sweet and sour sauce was fantastic! The food was kept spotless, and the owner even asked if we wanted some chicken oil to mix with the rice, which was so thoughtful. The soup dumplings were also great; they were so delicious that they were gone before I could even take a picture!

reviewReply.comment: 哎唷～看到這個分享真的會笑出來啦😊 泰式雞腿就是要皮酥酥才過癮，闆娘那個自製酸辣醬也是她的小驕傲，聽到您喜歡她一定很開心～餐點乾乾淨淨是基本，至於怕你吃不飽多問一句，那真的就是媽媽本能了啦😆 湯包來不及拍照就消失，這個我們懂～下次記得先拍再吃，不然又會被秒殺！期待您再來坐坐，繼續幫您餵飽飽☺️🥟🍗

reviews.comment:
I ate a plate of steamed vegetarian dumplings, and then ordered a 2nd plate. Spicy chili sauce is available to add too!

It was great to have vegetarian dumplings that tasted unique: these had something in them that just made them flavorful and scrumptious.

There is also a vegetarian Udon dish - maybe next time if I can resist the dumplings.

reviewReply.comment:
Thank you so much for sharing this! 😊 We’re really happy you enjoyed the steamed vegetarian dumplings—ordering a second plate is the best compliment! That little “something special” you tasted is exactly what we hope people notice. And yes, the spicy chili sauce is always ready for those who like an extra kick 🌶️

Next time, if you can resist the dumplings, the vegetarian udon will be waiting for you—but no worries if the dumplings win again, that happens a lot 😉 We look forward to welcoming you back for another warm, tasty meal!
